subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate phrasal verb to fill in the blank.**

The details were ___________ from one person to the other within no time.
solution: The correct answer is: **Passed down**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Passed down** means to transfer something (such as information or an object) to someone else, usually to a younger generation or someone who comes after you. (किसी चीज़ (जैसे सूचना या वस्तु) को किसी और को हस्तांतरित करना, आमतौर पर युवा पीढ़ी को या आपके बाद आने वाले किसी व्यक्ति को) • **Example**: *The tradition of storytelling has been passed down through generations in our family.* • In this context, the details were transferred or relayed from one person to another. • Therefore, 'passed down' is the appropriate phrasal verb to use here. Thus, **option 3** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Passed away: **It is commonly used to convey the idea of someone's death in a more sensitive or gentle manner. • **Passed in: **This phrase is not a widely recognized phrasal verb in English with a specific meaning. • **Passed out: **It can refer to someone losing consciousness or fainting. It can also mean distributing or handing out something, like passing out flyers. 3d:T9ee, The correct answer is: **quiet**.
